notes.content:

Hey everyone!

We've got a few fixes and balance tweaks going live today alongside some special content to celebrate the massive [url=https://zerator.com/#/zlan2019]ZLAN tournament[/url] taking place this weekend.

notes.title: Penthouse Update Goes Live!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11756575/494282217f4d01bafebe8cd88820b48248ea3908.gif[/img]
Greetings all!

It has been far too long since our last update but we have just launched the new map alongside a bunch of new content!  Once the patch is live across all platforms, we will begin Season 2 and activate the playlist for the new mode: Disc Dodger!  

Please see below for patch notes:

[list]
[*][b]NEW[/b]: Added a tiled arena -- The Penthouse.

[*][b]NEW[/b]: Added a game mode -- Disc Dodger (more info on this to follow!)

[*][b]NEW[/b]: 156 [b]NEW[/b] content items:

[list]
  [*] 13 discs
  [*] 36 skins
  [*] 15 taunts
  [*] 18 victory poses
  [*] 18 emblems
  [*] 56 tags
[/list]

[*][b]NEW[/b]: Match settings can now be customized in private, LAN, and splitscreen matches.

[*][b]NEW[/b]: Added Cinematic Instant Replays for epic rallies.

[*][b]NEW[/b]: Added Player Highlight Vignette following Instant Replays.

[*][b]NEW[/b]: Server region and instance ID can now be viewed on the in-game scoreboard menu.

[*][b]TWEAKED[/b]: Normalized throw timing between forehand and backhand animations.

[*][b]TWEAKED[/b]: Added 100ms across the board to all super throw timers.

[*][b]TWEAKED[/b]: Slightly decreased Gator's slide recovery.

[*][b]TWEAKED[/b]: Slight increase to Kahuna's blue throw.

[*][b]TWEAKED[/b]: Increase Kahuna curve width.

[*][b]TWEAKED[/b]: Gave Kahuna's slide a bit more distance.

[*][b]TWEAKED[/b]: Quick curves are now capped as to how wide they can go.

[*][b]TWEAKED[/b]: Throw timer now continues to tick down after the disc is caught while sliding. Getting up from a slide and throwing with perfect timing will still result in throwing the disc with a blue trail.

[*][b]TWEAKED[/b]: Deflecting a disc at the net with a fully charged shield now performs a stuff block instead of charging a super throw.

[*][b]FIXED[/b]: The indicator at a player's feet will no longer erroneously display purple even though the disc is thrown with a blue trail.

[*][b]FIXED[/b]: Player names are now displayed correctly on all viewports while playing splitscreen.

[*][b]FIXED[/b]: Adjust Lannie's animations that were keeping her in her throw stance for too long.

[*][b]FIXED[/b]: Updated Haruka cloth simulation to address interpenetration issues.

notes.title: Patch 1.10 Tomorrow: Introducing Tickets!
notes.content:
Although we underestimated the time it would take to get this update through QA, patch 1.10 will finally be released tomorrow afternoon. This update includes cross-play between platforms but it also includes another highly requested item: no more duplicates in the Prize Machine!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11756575/f91c054478891c5ed2bd9e1b5750c501e0ff606f.png[/img]

Instead of duplicates, players will now receive Tickets. The rarer the capsule, the more you will receive. Once you have accumulated enough Tickets, items can be purchased directly from the Customization menu rather than having to wait for them to pop out of the Prize Machine. This way you're always making progress when visiting the Prize Machine and you'll also be able to save up to get that specific item you've been waiting for!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11756575/71b2b1d368f4bea6d006b8628f950bc2ca3fcd41.png[/img]

Here are the full patch notes:
[list]
[*] NEW: Disc Jam now supports cross-play!
[list]
[*] Get matched with players on other platforms by toggling the option in the matchmaking settings popup.
[*] Leaderboards now list all players but can be filtered by platform.
[/list]

[*] NEW: Introducing tickets! Instead of salvaging duplicates from the Prize Machine, players will now receive tickets. These tickets can then be redeemed inside the Customize menu to unlock a specific piece of content directly.

[*] NEW: Players can now be reported from the in-game scoreboard.
[list]
[*] Reports can be submitted for players who are griefing, harassing other players, or who have inappropriate names.
[/list]

[*] FIX: Taskbar once again flashes when a match is found.

[*] FIX: Fixed the timer displayed for remote party members while matchmaking.

[*] FIX: Fixed up our Beam integration now that Beam has been rebranded as Mixer.

[*] FIX: Fixed a bug where opening the in-game menu with the scoreboard open could cause the menu to lose focus when the scoreboard button is released.
[/list]

notes.title: Dedicated Servers are LIVE!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11756575/f286e8962d76397fc7c7df2b9f9c4d2878a40f10.png[/img]

Hey everyone,

Dedicated servers are live on PC!  See our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/415880/announcements/detail/1305326168716410612]preview post[/url] for more info on what this means for Disc Jam.  There will be a dev stream tomorrow (Thursday) at 11AM PST where we'll play a little, discuss the update, and talk about what to expect in the upcoming patches.  In the meantime, we've hit some of your top requests in this update so check out the patch notes below and have fun!

[list]
[*] NEW: Disc Jam now uses dedicated servers powered by Amazon GameLift for public matches!
[*] NEW: Matchmaking has been completely rewritten from the ground up.
    [*] Queue for singles and doubles simultaneously!
    [*] Queue in multiple regions simultaneously!
    [*] Matchmaking will now gradually increase the skill range filter until a match is found!
[*] NEW: Singles and Doubles are now split into their own Skill Ratings. These new Skill Ratings default to your previous Skill Rating, but require 10 additional placement matches before they are calculated and listed on their respective leaderboards.
[*] TWEAKED: Players will now receive a skill rating change after a match even if their opponents are still in their placement matches.
[*] TWEAKED: Toned down footstep volume.
[*] TWEAKED: Stuff blocks now show a landing point on the ground where opponents can charge up.
[*] TWEAKED: Percentage-based stats now require a minimum amount of play before they are calculated and listed in leaderboards. Leaderboards have been reset as a result. Players will be relisted after they complete their next match.
[*] FIXED: When deflecting the disc at the net with a fully charged shield, players will now charge up a super instead of performing a stuff block.
[*] FIXED: Fixed a bug that could prevent a Steam invite from being successfully accepted at the title screen.
[/list]

notes.title: Disc Jam Dedicated Servers!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11756575/636ee209f5c0dd4264b5e2d1bed83fadaf4ddcfb.gif[/img]

Hey everyone,

It's been a while since our last patch, but that's because we've been working on something big!  We're excited to report that we're rolling out dedicated servers for Disc Jam!!!  We've been working with Amazon GameLift to setup fleets all over the world and deliver the best network experience possible.  

This is big change for a lot of reasons, some of which won't be fully realized until future updates, but here are some immediate benefits:
[list]
[*]Drastically improved matchmaking
[list]
      [*]This is especially true for Doubles where connection difficulties are compounded by each joining player (and the inevitable router/NAT/firewall troubles that come with them)
[/list]
    [*]More reliable connections across the board
        [list]
[*]No more bad hosts piggybacking on their neighborhood McDonald's WiFi!
[*]Someone's bad Internet is their own problem and will not affect your inputs to the game host
[/list]
    [*]Less volatility in latency (lower average ping)
    [*]Better handling of opponent disconnects
        [list][*]Quitters are guaranteed the loss.[/list]
    [*]You can now simultaneously queue for singles and doubles, and in multiple regions.
    [*]Skill-based matchmaking will now relax over time, eventually considering players of all skill levels to ensure you get into a match.
        [list][*]This should result in lower average queue times for everyone![/list]
[/list]

We think that's a pretty great list of day 1 benefits that come along with dedicated servers, but it's important to keep in mind that this is only the first part of a long-term initiative.  Here's what we're hoping these servers will enable us to do in the future:
[list]
   [*]Cross-play between PC and PS4
        [list][*]This is a big one.  We have a working proof-of-concept for the technology to do this today, but we still need to complete the work as well as go through a Sony approval process. If successful, we will be able to leverage this technology to join our player bases together and increase the matchmaking pool for everyone![/list]
    [*]Ranked seasons and other competitive features
        [list][*]Dedicated servers provide both a neutral and secure host for matches.  This allows us to start building a competitive framework into the game without having to worry about host advantage, players hosting with poor connections, lag switching, etc.[/list]
    [*]Private matches between players spanning large geographic distances.
        [list][*]Until now, it's been difficult for players spanning large geographic distances to play with/against each other due to high latency.  Although dedicated servers will only host public matches at first, we hope to expand their use to private matches where, for example, a player in Los Angeles could compete against a player in London provided both can make a reasonable connection (<150ms) to a data center on the US East Coast.[/list]
[/list]

So as you can see, this is big news indeed!  We'll be rolling this out in stages over the next few weeks.  The first step is to activate fleets for PC (Steam) and release a new patch with the improved matchmaking.  Our goal is to get that done by the end of the week.  Once we've had enough time to evaluate the technology and iron out the kinks, we will begin activating fleets for PS4 and pushing out the update there as well.

Hey everyone!

Pretty exciting build update this week with some significant changes to the charge and deflection mechanics.  This is a more experimental build than usual so we hope you'll reserve judgement until you've had some time to digest these changes and, as always, give us your feedback on our discord or subreddit!  

Patch Notes:
[list]
[*]NEW: We now support a wider (no pun intended) range of aspect ratios! Both 4:3 and 21:9 are supported! (EXPERIMENTAL)
[*]NEW: Added in-game matchmaking region selection. We try to default to a reasonable region, but make sure to select the region nearest you when searching for games!
[*]NEW: Added maximum ping filter when matchmaking. Selecting lower values should mean better connections, but may also result in longer matchmaking times!
[*]NEW: In the Options menu, streamers can now select a delay for the chat bot. This is useful in preventing the bot from spoiling the outcome of matches.
[*]NEW: Partially charged supers now grant the player extra time for a perfect throw.
[*]IMPROVED: The charge meter material has been changed to clamp instead of blend between throw speed colors (pink/blue/white).
[*]IMPROVED: If a host leaves a match mid-game, you will not matchmake back into them for a short while.
[*]IMPROVED: Discs will no longer allow you to catch them after reaching the ground/endzone in high latency matches. The disc may still freeze while you catch up to the server, but this prevents false catches/throws.
[*]IMPROVED: Fixed up physics collision in the map so that ragdolls respond better when colliding with the environment.
[*]IMPROVED: Bumped up knockback force from the disc explosion when you're sliding/bonked.
[*]TWEAKED: If your shield isn't fully powered, you can no longer charge supers off of deflections (landing point marker has been removed).
[*]TWEAKED: Deflection distance has been pulled in a bit closer to the player.
[*]TWEAKED: Slight buff to Stanton's weakest throw speed (white throw)
[*]TWEAKED: Replaced "Bring it!" quick chat with "So greedy."
[*]TWEAKED: Slight nerf to Makenna's fast (blue) throw speed
[*]TWEAKED: Tiniest of nerfs to Makenna's lob
[*]TWEAKED: Small buff to Gator's fast (blue) throw speed
[*]TWEAKED: Small buff to Gator's slide speed
[*]TWEAKED: Buffed Gator's lob
[*]TWEAKED: Punched up disc emissive on standard disc
[*]TWEAKED: Getting bonked now correctly takes into account the direction of the disc's velocity
[*]TWEAKED: Fixed bug that could prevent players from catching the disc while charging up at a landing point.
[*]TWEAKED: When a remote player disconnects from the host, the opposing team is now correctly given the win.
[*]TWEAKED: Disc shadow no longer flickers
[*]TWEAKED: In 2v2, your player will no longer be movement-assisted toward the disc's landing point if your partner is already charging up on it.
[*]TWEAKED: Beam integration now completely tears down and reconnects between matches. Hopefully, this will resolve any issues with the integration failing to start.
[*]TWEAKED: Fixed bug preventing footprints from appearing on the court.
[*]TWEAKED: Party members now display the correct Tag.
[*]TWEAKED: Players no longer continue running in place if the host disconnects.
[*]TWEAKED: Players no longer continue shielding if the host disconnects.
[*]TWEAKED: Stream integration should no longer turn on during training.
[*]TWEAKED: Party clients now correctly travel back to the main menu with the party host after leaving a match.
[*]TWEAKED: Party clients should now receive more regularly updates regarding the status of the party.
[/list]

[h1]Chat with us on Reddit and Discord[/h1]
First off, we want to announce our [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/DiscJam]reddit page[/url] has been updated and will be our primary forum going forward.  We also have a [url=discord.discjamgame.com]Discord server[/url] for players to find matches, discuss new mechanics, and give feedback.

Now, onto the good stuff!

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*] NEW: Overhauled the deflection mechanic.
[list]
[*] Hold A to charge shield which now slows you down over time.
[*] A fully charged shield guarantees a super.
[*] The supers have all been buffed to compensate for the increased difficulty in execution.
[/list]
[*] NEW: Overhauled the lob mechanic.
[list]
[*] Lobs no longer contribute to the perfect/juice system and in fact will break your perfect streak if deployed.
[*] Aiming lobs is no longer restricted by horizontal damping.  You should be able to place the lob anywhere on the court from any position.
[*] Timing does not affect the success of the lob throw.  You will throw the same lob if you hold it and run for a bit.
[*] Visuals and physics completely reworked.  The shot flies up high quickly then floats downward with very little forward movement.
[*] This fixes issues catching lobs from very far in front of the landing point.
[/list]
[*] NEW: Perfect timing on supers results in a SUPER RETURN which fires back a super based on whatever throw button was pressed
[*] NEW: Quick chat has been added on the D-Pad for easy mid-game communication.  There are 4 categories (Cheers, Jeers, Bold, Cold) with 4 phrases in each.  Taunt has been moved to RB as a result.
[*] NEW: Added audio and visual cue for wall skips so it is much easier read when one is incoming
[*] NEW: Added 10 new player emblems
[*] NEW: Disc hologram is now a generic locator disc shape
[*] NEW: Laser pylons now blast the disc on all winning points (previously only blasted on goals)
[*] FIXED: Point starts correctly at (5) and aces are now worth double points (10)
[*] FIXED: Deflections no longer bring you forward and are directed primarily for setting up the new charge/super mechanic.  There is no longer an offensive advantage to quick tapping the shield
[*] FIXED: Corrected material slots on the discs which was causing overly bright materials on Future disc (hopefully addresses the 'wobble' issue that was brought up)
[*] FIXED: Quit buttons re-added for PC only (were removed for PS4)
[*] FIXED: Spamming purchase button with insufficient funds no longer triggers audio nightmare
[*] FIXED: Hid tutorial button from party clients
[*] FIXED: Chat box scrolling no longer trims off the bottom line of long posts
[*] FIXED: Rapid wall bounce issue on Pythagoras has been fixed
[*] FIXED: Can no longer be scored on while charging a super from the edge of the end zone
[*] FIXED: Removed "Rematch" option from spectators in post game screen
[*] FIXED: Game camera now properly tracks the ragdolls during post-point fanfare 
[*] TWEAKED: Punched up Makenna's "Loser" pose and Stanton's "Yay" pose
[/list]

notes.title: Playtest Today: Get Stuffed!
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*] NEW: Added 'Stuff Block' mechanic! While standing at the net, deflecting a disc will send it straight back to your opponent's side of the court. They must slide to retrieve it before it hits the ground.
[*] NEW: Catch collision algorithms have been revamped. The new calculations are much more responsive and include different hitboxes for standing, charging up, and sliding. This should help everyone's throw timing considerably since the visuals and timing of the catch now match up more closely. This should also reduce some network desync artifacts.
[*] NEW: If playing windowed, the Disc Jam window will now be brought to the front when a match is found.
[*] TWEAKED: Throws that are going to skip along the wall are now tilted considerably. This is an effort to make it more clear when the disc will skip vs bounce.
[*] TWEAKED: Deep lobs now travel faster.
[*] TWEAKED: Deflecting a fast/perfect/super throw is now more of a penalty and will often require a quick slide to recover the disc.
[*] FIXED: Squashed bug where the disc could disappear while players were battling it out at the net.
[*] FIXED: Rare desync that could occur where one player sees the disc bounce and the other sees it skip along the wall.
[*] FIXED: Only one teammate can charge up at a time.
[*] FIXED: The player that is charging up is always the one guaranteed to catch the disc.
[*] FIXED: Players can no longer pass to a teammate while they've been knocked down.
[*] FIXED: Players can no longer catch a falling disc while they've been knocked down.
[*] FIXED: Disc now spins in the correct direction for all throws.
[/list]
[h1]Want to watch and live chat with us?[/h1]

In the meantime, make sure you've redeemed your Steam key and downloaded the game client. If you haven't yet received your key and you're unable to get one from [url=discjamgame.com]discjamgame.com[/url], please check out [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/415880/discussions/0/412446890552856201]this post[/url].

Definitely! Everyone is encouraged to stream the game and upload footage wherever they wish. We're excited to share the game with the world, build a community, and get everyone involved in helping us make Disc Jam the best game it can be.

notes.title: Announcing Thursday Night Jam! Weekly playtests beginning July 21st
notes.content:
Everyone has been asking for more opportunities to play Disc Jam, so today we’re happy to announce that you can play every week! Starting July 21st, Disc Jam will be online [b]every Thursday for 12 hours[/b]! We’re doubling the length of our playtest window in the hope that it will be easier for players in all parts of the world to find time to play.

[h1]THURSDAY NIGHT JAM[/h1]
[b]Every Thursday – Starting July 21st[/b]
3pm to 3am EST (New York)
12pm to 12am PST (Los Angeles)
16:00 to 4:00 BRST (São Paulo)
19:00 to 7:00 GMT (London)
20:00 to 8:00 CET (Paris)
22:00 to 10:00 MSK (Moscow)

[h1]Why the wait? I want to play RIGHT NOW![/h1]
Well, we’re still investigating bug reports from our last test, but we’ve also got some really exciting changes to gameplay and scoring in the works and we need to get them finished up before we make another build. We’ll be putting up another blog post soon with more details on what’s new!

[h1]Why this day and time? I can’t play![/h1]
A few months ago, we sent out a survey asking players their ideal playtest times and the vast majority of respondents said that weeknights were best. We chose Thursday evenings so that we could respond to feedback on Fridays and iterate on that feedback at the start of the following week. We understand that some people may not be able to play on Thursdays, but we feel it is important to have a regular schedule that players can rely on. If enough people are participating, we will open up a second day of the week for testing.
